name: Leaves blow across frame
text: Dry leaves blow across the frame.
desc: Season and wind. Motion in an empty exterior with nobody to carry it.
verdict: RENDERED 2026-08-04, 3 seeds. Motion 0.904/0.913/2.647 - two seeds barely above the band, one well above the ceiling. On 7701 a handful of small leaves drift through from f41; it is a long way from the frame-crossing gust the card implies. Tested on an INTERIOR keyframe, which is unfair to it - retest on an exterior before writing it off. Band 0.406-0.744 (empty control 0.628); frame-scale ceiling 1.191.
